source.notes: Current build resolves BACKGROUND_BASE_LOWER in YouBarFloatingShade. The native chat backdrop also references this key.

privacy.notes: Whole frames show synthetic avatars, author, channel, and messages. No personal content appears.

visual.notes: The gradient behind the composer changes. The screenshot dimensions, message layout, and restored appearance match.

annotation.notes: Outline sits inside the changed gradient without covering the composer or any text.

unrelatedComponents.notes: The changed pixels are confined to the bottom backdrop, including edges composited over it.

description.notes: Colours the gradient behind the floating chat composer.
